dialogues.speaker: Jiuguan
dialogues.text: There are many intricacies to drinking tea... Clear your mind, take a sip of tea, and sense the whispers within your drink. That is the attitude all tea lovers should have...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How incredibly sophisticated...

dialogues.speaker: Jiuguan
dialogues.text: It's just a habit. Tea-tasting habits differ among tea lovers from place to place.

dialogues.speaker: Jiuguan
dialogues.text: Fontainians prefer sipping tea while watching a play or film, and some even add milk and spices.

dialogues.speaker: Jiuguan
dialogues.text: Most of them treat tea as a common beverage, no different from coffee or alcohol.

dialogues.speaker: Jiuguan
dialogues.text: But in my opinion, tea tasting for the residents of Chenyu Vale revolves around the concept of peace and exploration...

dialogues.speaker: Jiuguan
dialogues.text: Yes, peacefully exploring the tea's original flavor.

dialogues.speaker: Jiuguan
dialogues.text: Tea tasting seems closer to a ritual people practice after a busy day to relieve themselves of the bustle and clear their minds...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What other insights and wisdom can you share? Please, enlighten me...

dialogues.speaker: Jiuguan
dialogues.text: We merely met by chance and had a short conversation, so such politeness isn't necessary.

dialogues.speaker: Jiuguan
dialogues.text: Tea tasting comes later, and tea preparation comes first. If we do plan to go into it, then we must discuss tea preparation first. And the specifics of it depend on the type of tea.

dialogues.speaker: Jiuguan
dialogues.text: For example, Yunlai White Tea is shaped like a silver needle and should not be brewed with boiling water. The water must be allowed to cool until it's at 70% of its boiling temperature.

dialogues.speaker: Jiuguan
dialogues.text: First, wet the tea with some hot water, then pour an appropriate amount of water into the pot. Wait patiently for ten minutes until the tea turns a light amber hue. Only then should you take a sip.

dialogues.speaker: Jiuguan
dialogues.text: The brewing steps are reversed for Bishui Green Tea. It requires pouring the water first, then the tea leaves...

dialogues.speaker: Jiuguan
dialogues.text: And Single-Origin Yauwan Tea, one of the teas Chenyu Vale is famous for, requires brewing at high temperatures. Boiling water must be used after letting it stand for a short moment...

dialogues.speaker: Jiuguan
dialogues.text: Besides that, Single-Origin Yauwan Tea should be paired with small teapots and teacups, and every pot must not be filled with too much water...

dialogues.speaker: Jiuguan
dialogues.text: I fear that the details cannot be captured with so few words.

dialogues.speaker: Jiuguan
dialogues.text: Fortunately for you, I heeded Mr. Fryslan's advice and made the artisans of my teahouse co-write a book on tea preparation and tasting.

dialogues.speaker: Jiuguan
dialogues.text: If you would like to delve deeper into the various teas and their intricacies, you can consider waiting until the book is finished. I'm certain a careful read of it will enlighten you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I will be back to hear a detailed explanation from you...

dialogues.speaker: Jiuguan
dialogues.text: Well then, until we meet again.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is it really that serious...?

dialogues.speaker: Jiuguan
dialogues.text: Hmm, perhaps my words were too formal, and caused you confusion.

dialogues.speaker: Jiuguan
dialogues.text: Tasting tea is itself a relaxing experience. No need for baths and changing clothes and burning incense and all that performative posing and etiquette. Just sit back and enjoy!

dialogues.speaker: Jiuguan
dialogues.text: I hope that you too will discover inner peace while sipping tea.
